m1.text: Wallpaper colours in Edit Desktop's THEME tab · issue #28

p2.text:
Proposed manifest addition (optional; the api stays 1). A top-level "settingsInfo" beside "settings", so "settings" keeps its plain name: default form and older shells read the plugin unchanged.

"settingsInfo": {
  "url": { "label": "Server address", "description": "Where your status page lives.", "group": "Connection" },
  "refreshMinutes": { "label": "Check every", "min": 1, "max": 60, "step": 1, "unit": "minutes", "group": "Connection" },
  "style": { "label": "Style", "choices": [ { "value": "cards", "label": "Cards" }, "list", "dots" ], "group": "Look" },
  "notes": { "multiline": true }
},
"groups": ["Connection", "Look"]

Fallbacks, each field on its own:
- no label: the key split at capitals ("refreshMinutes" becomes "Refresh minutes"), with the raw key under it
- no description: nothing under the label
- number with min and max: slider, value badge with the unit; otherwise a stepper (step 1, or "step")
- string with choices: chips (a plain string choice is its own value and label); otherwise a text field; multiline: a taller field
- true / false: the toggle tile
- no group: one list in manifest order; grouped ones follow "groups", ungrouped last
A value outside min / max or not in choices is shown as it is, marked changed, so nothing is silently rewritten.

p3.text:
Skipped plugins in plain words (and who fixes it). The shell's own message stays underneath in small code, for bug reports.
- plugin.json is not valid JSON / must be an object: "Its plugin.json has a mistake in it, so the shell can't read it." Fix: the plugin's author.
- written for plugin api N, N above 1: "Made for a newer SekaiPop than this one." Fix: update SekaiPop (Check for updates).
- written for plugin api N, N below 1: "Made for an older SekaiPop." Fix: update the plugin (git pull in its folder).
- id does not match its folder: "Its folder is named differently from its id." Fix: you, rename the folder to the id.
- folder name not an id: "The folder's name can't be a plugin id." Fix: you, lower case letters, digits and dashes.
- no plugin.json: "This folder has no plugin.json, so it isn't a plugin." Fix: you, check the clone or remove the folder.
- needs a name / version / api, bad setting or secret: "Its plugin.json is missing or misspells: <field>." Fix: the plugin's author.

ts1.text: Tailscale for SekaiPop: bar entry, popup, desktop widget

ts2.text:
Bar entries for plugins: the proposal (the api stays 1; every field is optional, so no plugin breaks)

plugin.json gains "bar": { "label": "Tailscale", "icon": "hub" }: the module's name and icon in Settings › Bar and on Edit Desktop's BAR tab. Bar.qml and Popup.qml sit beside Widget.qml; either is optional, and Popup.qml without Bar.qml is ignored.

1. Housing: the shell draws the pill (the Pill StatusPill uses: outline, ring, fill, hard shadow; a flat chip in the Capsule style; held pressed while its popup is open). Bar.qml draws only what is inside, so an entry fits all four bar styles without knowing them. No frame: false for the bar.
2. host.bar, for Bar.qml: vertical, edge, capsule, ink and inkSub (already the right ink for where it sits: the bar body or a Capsule chip), popupOpen. A left click opens and closes the popup by default; Bar.qml's own MouseArea may take middle and right clicks.
3. Popup.qml is the face of a SekaiPopup card: the shell places it under the entry, pops it in and out, closes it on a click away or Escape, and keeps one popup open at a time. Its size is implicitWidth x implicitHeight, clamped to 280-480 wide and 70 % of the screen tall. host.popup.close() for actions that end it (Sign in, Admin console).
4. One poll for three surfaces: an optional Service.qml, made once per plugin and handed to Widget, Bar and Popup as host.service. host.working is true while any surface shows; host.wanted says which ("bar" alone: check slowly; "popup" / "widget": check at the setting's pace).
5. Theme names to promise. Bar.qml and Popup.qml sit on the bar family, not the panel one: surface, surfaceHover, surfaceDivider, ink, inkSub, line, lineShadow, ringWhite, surfaceRing. Plus one status colour, warnFill (the Updates badge's amber #ffb74d, the same in every palette, colBorder ink on it). Online is accentMint, offline a hollow ring in inkSub, so no green or grey is needed; shape carries it as well (filled / hollow / amber diamond).
6. Not included: turning Tailscale on or off, or choosing an exit node. Both need root or the operator setting; a later version could offer them only when tailscale set --operator is in place.

ts3.text:
Reading the data, and what the design decided
- This machine: BackendState Running = On; Stopped = Off; NeedsLogin = Signed out (AuthURL behind Sign in); Starting = Connecting; "failed to connect to local tailscaled" = No tailscaled. No tailscale command at all = not installed: the entry hides (a setting, on by default) and the plugin's row in Settings says "tailscale not found on PATH".
- The count: online peers / all peers. This machine is not counted; the icon says its state. Only mine = peers whose UserID is Self's.
- Order: this machine on top in its own block, with its IP and MagicDNS name to copy; then online devices by name; then offline ones by LastSeen, newest first. Attention never moves a row, so nothing jumps while you look.
- Attention, quietly: KeyExpiry within 7 days = amber diamond + "key ends in N days" (and a small diamond on the bar icon); reached through DERP (Relay set, CurAddr empty) = "via relay fra", no colour. Active = arrows glyph pulsing slowly. ExitNodeOption = "offers exit node"; ExitNode = "exit node".
- Offline: hollow dot, name in inkSub, "2 h ago" from LastSeen. Folded under "Offline · N" (the setting's default) once more than 3 are offline.
- Popup: 360 wide, grows to 9 rows then scrolls with a fade; long names ellipsize, the IP line stays. A row click copies its IP (the key says Copied for 1.5 s); hover shows IP / DNS keys. Footer: Admin console, and when it last checked.
- Widget: 374 x ~330 drawn with the shell's frame; rows copy on click; the header and margins are plain card for dragging. Compact: 182 square. Shelf tile: the widget's picture, after the built-in tiles, the puzzle mark on its name.
- Motion: a dot fills or empties (150 ms), the count ticks, the Active glyph pulses. Nothing else moves.
